name: errors
about: RFC-0008 phase 7, wave 2: new errors (GlitchTip). The expected issues are status.json's errors.new (GlitchTip issues first seen in the last 24 h, computed by the hub), fetched just before and after the question; the answer passes when it names every one by its short id.

questions.q: Which new errors appeared in GlitchTip in the last 24 hours? For each: short id, project, and how many times it happened.
